channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Oil flows nearly tripled before US-Iran MoU expired, analysis shows
item.description: Some 374 million barrels of oil exited the Gulf during 60-day window covered by MoU, Kpler data shows.

item.title: Australian anger as Israel drops World Central Kitchen deaths case
item.description: Australia has summoned the Israeli ambassador in anger over the country’s decision not to pursue criminal proceedings.

item.title: At least 6 killed in multiple Russian missile strikes across Ukraine
item.description: Russian ballistic missiles killed at least six people and ⁠injured over two dozen more in Kyiv early on Thursday.

item.title: Trump vows ‘economic warfare’ on countries helping Iran
item.description: US President Donald Trump has threatened ‘economic D-Day’ on any countries that help or do business with Iran.

item.title: Russian forces kill 9 in Ukraine as Zelenskyy faces pressure over elections
item.description: Russian ballistic missile attacks hit at least three districts in Kyiv, collapsing buildings and causing fires.

item.title: Alarm in South Korea as Iran dispute with Trump shakes a 72-year alliance
item.description: Trump's order to scale back military drills rattles Seoul, reviving doubts over US security guarantees.

item.title: Iran war live: Tehran says Trump’s ‘crushing economic’ measures will fail
item.description: Trump says Washington may resume talks with Tehran 'at some point'.

item.title: ‘We do not trust Israeli judiciary’ says Hind Rajab’s grandmother
item.description: The grandmother of Hind Rajab, a five-year-old Palestinian girl killed in her family’s car by Israeli forces in Gaza.

item.title: At least 13 killed in Kyiv as Ukraine grapples with air defence shortages
item.description: Apartment blocks and warehouses were targeted in the "massive attack" on Thursday, officials say.

item.title: Trump vows tougher economic measures on Iran and supporting countries
item.description: It comes after a 60-day ceasefire expired on Monday, with no sign of a diplomatic or military off-ramp to the conflict.
